items.summary: Add initialization logic to the backend main actor that automatically seeds the database with default job roles (Data Analyst, Web Developer, AI Engineer, DevOps Engineer, UI/UX Designer) when the canister is first deployed or when no job roles exist in the system

Define default job roles with realistic skill requirements including Data Analyst (SQL, Python, Excel, Statistics, Data Visualization, Power BI/Tableau), Web Developer (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Git, REST APIs), AI Engineer (Python, Machine Learning, TensorFlow/PyTorch, Deep Learning, NLP, Computer Vision), DevOps Engineer (Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS/Azure/GCP, Git, Bash scripting), and UI/UX Designer (Figma/Adobe XD, User Research, Wireframing, Prototyping, Visual Design, HTML/CSS basics)

Update the JobRoleSelector component to show a loading state while job roles are being fetched or seeded, displaying a spinner or skeleton loader instead of the 'No job roles available. Please contact an administrator.' error message when roles are still being initialized
